# Supported languages and codes

## Language notes[​](#language-notes "Direct link to Language notes")

Text translation supports 211 languages (excluding Traditional Chinese, Mongolian, and Cantonese), and any of these languages can be translated to any other. Traditional Chinese, Mongolian, and Cantonese support translation only to and from Chinese.

In addition, text translation supports automatic source language detection using the language code `auto` (however, `auto` is not supported when Cantonese is the source language).
